name: Elektron Digitone II
description: Elektron Digitone II FM synthesizer: every parameter of its manual's MIDI appendix, as the controllers and NRPNs it prints, on the track and FX control channels.

sources.title: Digitone II User Manual, OS 1.12
sources.notes: MIDI appendix read by tools/profiles/elektron/read-elektron-midi.mjs from Digitone-2-User-Manual_ENG_OS1.12_261008.pdf (sha256 389721d4e9935e13ea1cbd9a461efa10182124d6c2b8b9296fae1ea68a189e60), https://www.elektron.se/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Digitone-2-User-Manual_ENG_OS1.12_261008.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/elektron/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/elektron/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI appendix, with its printed name, sent on the CC it prints (a 14-bit pair where it prints an LSB), or its NRPN where it prints no CC. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The appendix prints no ranges: each parameter takes what its controller carries, 0 - 127 (0 - 16383 for a pair). What a value shows, and the values of a setting chosen from a list, are in the parameter's chapter of the manual.
The channel variable is a track's channel (track 1's by default): the parameters go to that track. Set it to the AUTO channel to edit whichever track is active.
Rows the appendix prints wrongly, given by the layout: AMP Sustain Level (cc 87, printed 86).

Printed twice on the same controller and channel, laid out once: EXTERNAL IN MIXER Input L R Level (the same as EXTERNAL IN MIXER Input L Level), EXTERNAL IN MIXER Input L R Balance (the same as EXTERNAL IN MIXER Input L Pan), EXTERNAL IN MIXER Input L R Delay Send (the same as EXTERNAL IN MIXER Input L Delay Send), EXTERNAL IN MIXER Input L R Reverb Send (the same as EXTERNAL IN MIXER Input L Reverb Send), EXTERNAL IN MIXER Input L R Chorus Send (the same as EXTERNAL IN MIXER Input L Chorus Send).
The fxChannel variable is 16 here: the manual prints no default for it; set it to the instrument's FX CONTROL CH (SETTINGS > MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS) setting.
The midiChannel variable is 9 here: the manual prints no default for it; set it to the instrument's MIDI track channel (SETTINGS > MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS) setting.
An NRPN-only parameter is sent as its number (MSB on CC 99, LSB on CC 98) and a 7-bit value on data entry (CC 6), which the appendix does not spell out; not checked against the instrument.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same controllers (or NRPNs, as its PARAM OUTPUT setting says) when its knobs are turned
